exposure: Traffic-related air pollution (PM10, NO2, O3, CO, SO2)
cohort: The study involved 388 children aged 2-4 years in Shenyang, China, where allergic rhinitis was clinically diagnosed.
finding: Early exposure to PM10 and NO2 was positively associated with allergic rhinitis in children aged 2-4 years, with this risk being increased among those with family stress and male gender.
